_method: Drizzle correlated-noise factor applied to cutout_[cr_]noise.fits by make_cutouts.py (precedence: 1.0 < this JSON < explicit --corr-factor). Measured 2026-09-26 by scripts/measure_corr_factor.py over all 157 standard 12" stamps: sqrt of the sigma-normalised blank-sky ACF summed over the drizzle kernel window |dx|,|dy| <= round(pixfrac * native/output scale) px, after subtracting the long-range floor (mean ACF at Chebyshev lags 7-12) and a 51 px median high-pass, 3-sigma source mask. Median over lenses; lens-to-lens spread is within measurement error, so one factor per instrument/detector/filter. Floored at 1.0 (never shrinks the map). Raw results: diagnostics/corr_factor/. See AGENTS.md *Drizzle correlated noise*.
